memoryRule: a wheel step misreads one weather form -> its contour opens -> a distant form borrows the wrong edge -> the shared horizon tilts to contain the error
interactionRule: wheel, ArrowUp/ArrowDown, Enter, Space, and the step control commit one bounded weather misread; Delete or undo latest restores the exact prior panorama
representationRupture: one hinged Canvas paper mechanism -> one continuous p5 panorama with a horizon, weather forms, and shared painted ground
encounterRupture: directional drag names a wrong neighbour -> wheel step advances a discrete misreading with no pointer-position state
temporalRupture: reversible hinge reassignment -> ordinal weather error that redraws the common horizon
promotion: candidate / held pending browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
